title: Two, five, one
summary: A short route back to the tonic.

steps.title: Two, five, one
steps.body:
ii–V–I in C is Dm–G–C. Start on the minor chord from degree 2, move to the major chord from degree 5, then return to the tonic chord.

**Why it matters:** This short route gives you another common way to finish a phrase.

steps.title: See it on the fretboard
steps.body: Dm has D, F, A; G has G, B, D; C has C, E, G. Keep the minor ii and major V/I distinct.

steps.title: Explore the sounds
steps.body: Try the same numbers in G: Am, D, G. Listen for the feeling of arriving on G.

items.prompt: In C major, which chord is the ii?
